simple.meaning: יָשְׁפֵה (yâshᵉphêh) is a Hebrew word meaning “a gem supposed to be jasper (from the resemblance in name).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: יָשְׁפֵה (H3471) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Exodus 28:20, with occurrences in Exodus, Ezekiel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to יָשְׁפֵה (H3471) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in יָשְׁפֵה (H3471) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: יָשְׁפֵה (yâshᵉphêh) / H3471 is traced through Exodus 28:20, Exodus 39:13, Ezekiel 28:13 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H3471. yashepheh יָָֽשְׁפֶה noun [masculine] jasper (loan-word from Persian so Arabic Lane 2978 , also (and on forms , ) Frey; perhaps Assyrian ašpû Dl HA 36 , HWB 147 ) — וְיָָֽשְׁפֵ֑ה וְשֹׁהַם תַּרְשִׁישׁ Exod 28:20 ; 39:13 (both P) beryl and onyx and jasper (see Di); וְיָָֽשְׁפֶ֔ה (+ id. ) Ezek 28:13 (see Sm). יִשְׁמָּה see below שׁפה ; יִשְׁמָּן see below שׁפן
